text:
maria g: Quick sync  we need to finalize the canary plan for the Q2 rate update. Key decisions: canary size, grandfather cutoff, and precise credit calc. I want a dry-run Friday. cc @kevin t @samir @jess l @nora

kevin t: Proposed canary = 5% (smaller than earlier) stratified by spend tier so we don't accidentally hit a mega-customer. We should export a sample invoice set to simulate credits.

samir: Rollback conditions: >3% net churn w/in 7d on canary OR >10 billing tickets from canary in 72h. Also watch revenue delta and cancellations tagged "pricing".

jess l: Legal asks: 30-day notice for major changes; grandfathering window needs to be explicit. Suggest customers created before 2026-01-01 get grandfathered for 60 days unless they opt-in. Will draft comms.

accounting-bot: Heads up: retro credits will produce negative invoice adjustments and may trigger dunning re-eval. See /runbooks/billing-retro-adjusts for automation steps and GL mapping.

maria g: Credit formula idea: prorate by overlapping days, exclude promotional discounts, cap at net-increase-per-invoice. Need finance sign-off on cap.

nora: Ops can add a boolean tag `pricing_mig_v2` and output CSV of affected customers. I can run the tagging job Sat 02:00 UTC during low traffic. Need final list by Fri 18:00 UTC.

kevin t: For the dry-run I created this sample SQL to pull impacted lines:
```
SELECT invoice_id, customer_id, amount, plan_version, usage_start, usage_end
FROM invoice_lines
WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30'
AND plan_version = 'v1'
LIMIT 1000;
```

kevin t: I'll also generate a CSV showing current vs post-rate amounts so accounting can validate AR flows.

ops-runner: Note: the credit job will create negative adjustments. We'll tag adjustments with `migration_run_id` and run reconciliation nightly. If more than 0.5% of adjustments fail to reconcile, we'll pause.

samir: Metrics dashboard items for SRE/Console team: canary churn, canary net revenue change, support ticket rate (billing+unexpected charge), 95p latency for API. We will instrument an A/B flag and expose canary metric cohort.

jess l: Dedicated customers policy: remain on existing contracted prices unless they explicitly allow migration. Add an opt-in toggle in the admin console and a short API for partners to opt-out. Legal prefers a logged consent for audit.

maria g: Approvals required by Fri: finance sign-off on refund cap, legal approval of comms, ops readiness (tag + job), and accounting runbook check. If all green, schedule progressive ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 weeks.

accounting-bot: Reminder: retro credits may affect tax calculation. Please coordinate with tax team and include tax-code on adjustment lines.

maria g: I'll post the draft customer email and the spreadsheet with simulated credits here by EOD. If no blockers, we'll proceed with staging dry-run on Sat. :thumbsup:
